data.name: Snehalata
data.gender_notes: Snehalata is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from Sanskrit, Sneha (heart) and Lata (bound). Snehalata means one who is heart bound, attached to love. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a goddess who embodies love and compassion. She is believed to nurture and protect the emotional bonds between loved ones. The name Snehalata carries the meaning “Heart bound, attached to love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Snehalata usually hope their child will grow to embody heart bound, attached to love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nurtures emotional bonds and embodies love and compassion
data.etymology: Snehalata belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heart bound, attached to love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Snehalata total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
